auditor.independence: None of these agents authored or edited the target translations. Subauditors were given committed English/target/context and guides only; suggestions have not been applied.

phase_models.phase_detail: DeepSeek performed the initial repository survey. Sonnet performed the TUI source/target/context comparison and mechanical probes. Five independent child auditors read all wire.settings keys under Sonnet after their DeepSeek quota fallbacks. GPT completed context coverage, reconciled findings/severity, and packaged evidence after a further provider-quota fallback. No model was a human/native speaker.

limitations: No lost scratchpad, screenshot, geometry-report.json, prior report hash, or old audit trajectory was reconstructed. The deletion date/count in the task are supplied incident context, not independently proven deletion events.

No live OperatorApp, real terminal/font, browser, native app, 60x24/100x24 frame or settled-frame equality was exercised. Those previous visual/geometry claims are UNVERIFIABLE in this re-audit. Rich cell_len and ICU output are scalar/text evidence only, not layout or shaping proof.

Style/semantic decisions are independent LLM review, not native-speaker certification. Hindi idiom would need a native speaker for that certification; none of these auditors is one. The operator waived human/native-speaker sign-off for all locales; it is not a merge gate here.
No catalogue text was changed. Proposed fixes are recommendations to a separate translator, not translations authored by this auditor and self-approved.

The full check.py result is from a SPARSE tree; its AST scanned-file count is not whole-repository coverage. --catalogues-only checked the complete carried catalogues. No full test suite or UI QA was run.

Sanctioned-reader receipts exist for the en source and the locale catalogue only; the en context sidecar is structurally refused by read_public_copy ("catalogue keys and values must be strings"), recorded verbatim in route-receipts.json. The judgments were formed on direct reads BEFORE the routed receipts were taken, and are not relabelled.
The routed receipts reproduce the tool's own audit-log lines, and each digest was independently recomputed from the base blob. They confirm bytes, not linguistic judgement.
